parameters.content:
## 1 · Two ways in, one path
**Webhook** for the AI chatbot / other systems (requires the `X-Clinic-Secret` header).
**Form** for patients on the website: it forwards each submission to the same webhook, so every message is handled by exactly the same logic.

parameters.formDescription: Book a visit or ask us anything – Arabic or English. احجز موعدك أو اسألنا أي سؤال.

values.placeholder: e.g. I'd like a cleaning appointment next Sunday at 6 pm

values.formSubmittedText: Thank you! We received your message and will reply shortly. شكراً لك! استلمنا رسالتك وسنرد عليك قريباً.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $json.Name, phone: $json.Phone, email: $json.Email, message: $json.Message, source: 'form' }) }}

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: Request must be JSON with a non-empty "message" field.

parameters.content:
## 2 · Understand the message (Google Gemini)
AI returns strict JSON: intent, urgency, language, name, phone, email, preferred date/time, summary.
The JSON is **validated**; if it is broken the AI is asked **once more**, then it falls back to *other*. Network errors retry 3× automatically.

## 3 · Urgent cases
Any message with **high urgency** (severe pain, swelling, bleeding...) instantly alerts the clinic on Telegram, while the normal flow continues (an urgent booking is still booked).

## 4 · Booking
No date or time → the patient is asked for it.
Complete → row in **Bookings** (status *Pending*), confirmation email in the patient's language, Telegram to the clinic. Staff set status to **Confirmed** in the sheet; reminders go out the day before.

Reference: ${$('Booking row').item.json.id}` }}

parameters.content:
## 5 · Questions – answered ONLY from the clinic FAQ
The FAQ (hours, address, services, prices) lives in one node and is easy to edit. If the answer is not in it, the patient is told the clinic will reply and the team is notified.

assignments.name: faq
assignments.value:
Clinic: Bright Smile Dental Clinic (demo data)
Opening hours: Saturday to Thursday 10:00–22:00. Friday closed.
Address: 15 Abbas El Akkad St, Nasr City, Cairo. Near City Stars. Street parking available.
Phone / WhatsApp: +20 100 000 0000
Services and prices (EGP):
- Check-up and consultation: 300
- Teeth cleaning (scaling and polishing): 600
- Tooth-coloured filling: 800 to 1,200
- Root canal treatment: 2,500 to 4,000
- Tooth extraction: 500 to 1,500 (surgical wisdom tooth from 2,000)
- Teeth whitening (in clinic): 3,500
- Braces / clear aligners: consultation 400, treatment plan priced after assessment
- Dental implants: from 15,000 per implant
- Children's dentistry: check-up 250
Payment: cash, cards, InstaPay. No installment plans.
Insurance: we accept AXA and MetLife (others: ask the front desk).
Appointments: booking recommended; walk-ins welcome if a dentist is free. Emergencies are seen the same day.

assignments.name: action_taken
assignments.value: ={{ $('Read FAQ answer').item.json.answered ? 'Answered from FAQ' : 'Not in FAQ – team notified' }}

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: ={{ $('Understood request').item.json.language === 'ar' ? `${$('Read FAQ answer').item.json.answered ? $('Read FAQ answer').item.json.answer : 'شكراً لسؤالك! سيرد عليك فريقنا في أقرب وقت.'}` : `${$('Read FAQ answer').item.json.answered ? $('Read FAQ answer').item.json.answer : 'Thanks for your question! Our team will reply to you soon.'}` }}

parameters.content:
## 6 · Complaints & other
Complaints alert the clinic immediately (**URGENT**) and the patient gets an apology. Spam/other is only logged.

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: ={{ $('Understood request').item.json.language === 'ar' ? `نأسف جداً لتجربتك${$('Understood request').item.json.name ? ' ' + $('Understood request').item.json.name : ''}. تم إبلاغ مدير العيادة وسيتواصل معك اليوم.` : `We're very sorry about your experience${$('Understood request').item.json.name ? ' ' + $('Understood request').item.json.name : ''}. The clinic manager has been notified and will contact you today.` }}

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: ={{ $('Understood request').item.json.language === 'ar' ? `شكراً لرسالتك. إذا كنت ترغب في حجز موعد أو لديك سؤال عن خدماتنا، أخبرنا.` : `Thanks for your message. If you'd like an appointment or have a question about our services, just tell us.` }}

parameters.content:
## 7 · Finish – same for every message
**Reply** to the caller as JSON `{ ok, intent, message }` · **log** every message in *Inquiries* · **email** the patient when there is an address.
